subject: POC environment dependencies - staging checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@nimbus-analytics.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment dependencies - staging checklist & next steps

Hi Sofia / Liam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed MAP milestone for the POC staging environment so we have clear owners and a target close for the infra gating work. I attached the checklist (spreadsheet) and a simple network diagram exported from our example template.

Summary of what we need from your side to unblock our dedicated POC run:
- VPC peering: confirm VPC IDs and peering contact (we need the peering request + acceptance window)
- IP allowlist: provide the CIDR ranges for your NAT/gateway egress so we can preconfigure the firewall rules
- SSO/SAML: Okta contact and SAML metadata (IdP entity ID, ACS URL) — we will perform a test SAML exchange in staging
- Secrets/KMS: KMS key ARN or KMS admin contact; if using customer-managed keys we need decrypt perms for our service account
- Service account & IAM: name of the service account that will be used for API auth (we will provide a minimal IAM policy)

Proposed milestone (MAP draft):
- Milestone: Staging environment ready for smoke tests
- Target date: 2027-04-05
- Owners: Nimbus infra (VPC peering, IP allowlist) / Nimbus SSO admin (SAML config) / Redwood (service IAM & KMS policy + initial smoke run)
- Dependencies: Peering acceptance, SAML metadata, KMS access granted, test dataset (we can use synthetic if needed)

Next steps I propose:
1) Nimbus to confirm VPC ID and point engineer + share expected maintenance window for peering (by 2027-03-24)
2) Nimbus SSO admin to share SAML metadata file or Okta org URL (by 2027-03-26)
3) Redwood to send a one-click peering request template and sample IAM policy (today) — aditya and karthik will follow up on the technical details

Can you confirm owners and the two dates above? If we get a green light we’ll lock the milestone and update the MAP.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: poc-staging-deps-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), nimbus-network-diagram.pdf (pdf)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@nimbus-analytics.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC environment dependencies - staging checklist & next steps

Sofia / Liam — adding a short technical action list from our side so owners are explicit.

Action items (Redwood):
- I will send the peering request template and sample security policy for your infra team to paste into their console (by EOD 2027-03-22) — owner: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
- karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com will follow up with the required outbound ports and sample CIDR ranges we expect to reach (we only need a handful of /32s for control plane + a small CIDR for workers)
- laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com (CS) will coordinate the smoke test window once peering + SAML are in place

Tentative internal timeline to meet the MAP target: if Nimbus confirms peering request by 2027-03-24 and SAML metadata by 2027-03-26, we can complete the staging smoke run by 2027-04-05. If either slips we will propose a 1-week buffer.

Also: small ask — do you have a preferred egress IP allowlist mechanism (static NAT or firewall rule group)? Static NAT is easiest for short-lived POCs.

Thanks — sending the peering template now.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineering (Sales Eng) | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Hi Mina / Aditya —

Thanks for the clear summary and checklist. Quick answers from my side:
- VPC ID: vpc-0a1b2c3d (peering owner: Liam Chen, liam.chen@nimbus-analytics.com). He'll accept the request but needs the template values filled (we asked Liam to look).
- IP allowlist: we prefer to use a small set of static NAT IPs for the POC. Our infra team will provide 3 public IPs (expected by 2027-03-24).
- SSO: we are on Okta. I'll ask our SSO admin to share the IdP metadata and the contact (expected 2027-03-26).
- KMS: we use AWS KMS; we can create a key and grant the Redwood service principal decrypt/encrypt. I'll loop in infra-team to confirm exact ARN (ETA 2027-03-25).

We attached a short internal network diagram and flagged the peering acceptance window (we have a maintenance blackout 2027-03-25 00:00-04:00 UTC). If you could avoid scheduled peering ops in that window that would be great.

Also, quick preference: please share the IAM policy as a JSON snippet rather than a console screenshot — our infra team can apply it directly.

Sofia
Sofia Morales
Director, Cloud Ops | Nimbus Analytics
sofia.morales@nimbus-analytics.com | +1 (650) 555-4421

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC environment dependencies - staging checklist & next steps

Hi all —

Thanks Sofia — that timing works. Two quick technical clarifications so we don't block on follow-ups:
1) CIDR & Ports: we'll need outbound to these endpoints: control plane (api.redwoodinference.com) on 443 (we'll provide exact IP set as /32s). Worker pool egress (for telemetry & checkpoints) will be a small CIDR; if you supply static NAT IPs that's ideal.
2) SAML: sample ACS URL for staging: https://staging-login.redwoodinference.com/saml/acs. We will accept standard Okta metadata; please confirm if you require SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows for the test.
3) KMS: if you create a customer-managed key please add the following principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-poc-role (we will provide a finished policy snippet).

I'll paste two quick snippets in the MAP doc on Drive so your infra team can copy/paste:
- sample IAM trust policy (role -> KMS decrypt)
- sample security group egress for control plane (list of /32s)

Laura — can you hold the smoke test slot week of 2027-04-05 pending the peering window? If peering slips we should aim for 2027-04-12.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
